items.name: Geometry and measurement
items.basis: Real entry points create LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, ELLIPSE, LWPOLYLINE, rectangle, MTEXT and single-boundary HATCH in both backends (ezdxf_backend.py create_*; mcp_dispatch.lsp mcp-cmd-create-*). entity get reads back start/end for LINE and center/radius for CIRCLE only.
items.scope_and_limits: Source reading only. No length/area/topology measurement exists in either backend; entity get returns geometry only for LINE and CIRCLE; ezdxf create_hatch only accepts entities with get_points (LWPOLYLINE), no islands. No committed result files, no golden output produced by the product code, and no GitHub Actions workflows or runs exist for this repository, so no output/behavioral evidence is available; under the brief, code without output evidence is capped at 1.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no measurement capability (length/area/topology) and no output evidence for any primitive; capped at 1.

items.name: Editing
items.basis: copy/move/rotate/scale/mirror/array exist in both backends; offset/fillet/chamfer only through AutoCAD commands in File IPC. Handles serve as entity identity.
items.scope_and_limits: Source reading only. No trim/join, no requirement-driven edits. ezdxf mirror adds the copy to modelspace before validating a zero-length mirror line, so the refused call still leaves a stray copy (ezdxf_backend.py L290-296). IPC copy/mirror/offset report the handle of (entlast) without checking that the command produced a new entity. No committed result files, no golden output produced by the product code, and no GitHub Actions workflows or runs exist for this repository, so no output/behavioral evidence is available; under the brief, code without output evidence is capped at 1.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no trim/join and no output evidence; capped at 1. The mirror partial-write would cap at 2 independently.

items.name: Security defaults
items.basis: No path restriction or operation scoping. execute_lisp (arbitrary AutoLISP) is enabled by default on the File IPC backend, sits in the 'system' tool annotated readOnlyHint=True, and the loader sets SECURELOAD to 0 while loading the code; the LISP header still states 'SECURITY: No raw eval'.
items.scope_and_limits: Source reading only; no exploit was run. drawing save/open/save_as_dxf/plot accept arbitrary paths (ezdxf saveas overwrites any writable path). stdio only, so no HTTP surface. This is a demonstrated permission defect (misleading read-only annotation plus default-enabled code execution).

deduction.reason: Withhold 5: no protective default is implemented; the default-enabled arbitrary-code path behind a read-only annotation is a serious permission defect.

items.name: Long tasks
items.basis: File IPC uses an asyncio.Lock for one in-flight command, a configurable timeout clamped to 1-300 s, request-id matching, atomic tmp-then-rename writes, stale-file cleanup, ESC prefix to cancel stuck commands, and structlog logging to stderr.
items.scope_and_limits: Source reading only. The lock is per process; c:mcp-dispatch processes whichever autocad_mcp_cmd_*.json it lists first, so two server processes sharing C:/temp can execute each other's commands. A timeout returns ok=false while AutoCAD may still complete the command, so the drawing state after a timeout is unknown. No cancellation API or crash recovery. No committed result files, no golden output produced by the product code, and no GitHub Actions workflows or runs exist for this repository, so no output/behavioral evidence is available; under the brief, code without output evidence is capped at 1.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: per-process locking only, unknown state after timeout, no output evidence; capped at 1.

declared_contract: MCP stdio server (v3.0.0 in pyproject, v3.1 in README/server) exposing 8 consolidated tools (drawing, entity, layer, block, annotation, pid, view, system) for AutoCAD LT 2024+ automation and headless DXF generation. Two backends: File IPC (Windows; Python writes JSON command files to C:/temp and posts '(c:mcp-dispatch)' keystrokes to AutoCAD LT, where mcp_dispatch.lsp runs AutoCAD commands and writes result files) and ezdxf (any platform, in-memory DXF, matplotlib screenshots). Declared scope: 2D primitives, basic transforms, layers, blocks/attributes, text/dimensions/leaders, P&ID symbols from the third-party CTO library, save/DXF/PDF, undo/redo and arbitrary AutoLISP via execute_lisp (File IPC).

serious_defects.description: File IPC block insert_with_attributes ignores the requested attributes (handler never reads them) and returns ok=true; omitted edit reported as success. Also counted under C2.

File IPC create/copy/mirror/offset/hatch report the handle of (entlast) without checking that the AutoCAD command created a new entity, so a failed command can return a pre-existing entity's handle with ok=true.
File IPC drawing-save, drawing-save-as-dxf, drawing-open and drawing-plot-pdf return ok=true unconditionally after issuing the command, without checking file existence or command completion.
ezdxf entity_mirror adds the copy before rejecting a zero-length mirror line, and create_hatch adds an empty HATCH before the boundary lookup can fail; failed calls leave partial writes.

execute_lisp (arbitrary AutoLISP, loaded with SECURELOAD temporarily 0) is enabled by default and exposed through the 'system' tool annotated readOnlyHint=True; the dispatcher header claims 'No raw eval'.
